examples.arabic: الجد ضحك وقال وعليكم السلام بس فين فطارك
examples.english: The grandfather laughed and said and upon you be peace but where is your breakfast
examples.transliteration: El ged dehek wa aal wa alaykum as salam bas feen fetarak

examples.arabic: الجد الكبير والولد الصغير بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة
examples.english: The old grandfather and the young boy are watching a football match.
examples.transliteration: El ged el kibeer wel walad el sagheer beitfaraggu 'ala match kora

examples.arabic: الجد قاله ازيك يا كريم انا كويس الحمد لله
examples.english: The grandfather said to him, "How are you, Karim? I'm good, alhamdulillah."
examples.transliteration: El-gadd qāllo: "Izzayyak ya Karim? Ana kwayyes, el-ḥamdulillah."

examples.arabic: الجد الكبير والولد الصغير بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة في التليفزيون
examples.english: The big grandfather and the small boy are watching a football match on television.
examples.transliteration: El-gadd el-kabeer wel-walad el-soghayyar beytfarragoa ala matsh koora fel-televezyoon.

examples.arabic: الجد قال زمان كان كل حاجة مختلفة
examples.english: The grandfather said, "In the past, everything was different."
examples.transliteration: el gadd aal zaman kan koll haga mokhtalefa

examples.arabic: الجد بحكمة رد بإن المتعة الحقيقية في المجهود واللمة مش بس في سهولة الوصول للحاجة زي ما الجيل الجديد بيفكر
examples.english: The grandfather wisely replied that the real joy is in the effort and the gathering, not just in the ease of getting things, as the new generation thinks.
examples.transliteration: El-gedd be-hekmma radd be'enn el-mot'a el-haqiqiya fel maghoud wel lamma mesh bas fe sohoolet el-wosoul lel-haga zay ma el-geel el-gedid beyfakkar
examples.storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation
